bibl.title: The Wet Nurses of Ptolemaic and Roman Egypt.
bibl.seg: Maryline Parca, The Wet Nurses of Ptolemaic and Roman Egypt.
bibl.note: Presents the extant evidence for nurses in wet-nursing contracts preserved on papyri from Egypt (46 texts, all but one of Roman date) and points out the ways in which the hiring of wet nurses in Roman Egypt can be distinguished from the practice documented for Italy and other parts of the empire.
